findings.claim: The test suite only covers the default chain (Ethereum) and does not verify that the closed trigger updates after selecting a different network, even though Polygon (137) is already present in the test data. As a result, a regression that hard-codes the default chain in the render function or drops the value={chainId} binding would not be caught; a test should be added that opens the select, picks 137, and asserts the trigger contains "Chain 137".
